treatment_records.name: methotrexate
treatment_records.reason_stopped: made him so nauseous he couldn't work

treatment_records.name: Humira
treatment_records.reason_stopped: starting to notice it's not working as well

evidence_notes: Diagnosed with Crohn's seven years ago, with severe inflammation. Initial treatments (prednisone, mesalamine, sulfasalazine, methotrexate) were ineffective or caused significant side effects. Remicade was tried, initially effective but eventually lost efficacy. Switched to Humira three years ago, which is now also showing signs of waning effectiveness. Patient faces challenges with the physical demands of his construction job, financial strain due to lost pay during infusions and increasing medical costs, and social isolation. He is worried about future treatment options (Stelara) and insurance battles, alongside lifestyle changes advised by his doctor (diet, alcohol reduction, exercise).
